crossRefs.note: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
